authority_basis.summary: Test whether the derived prime operations produce Euler factors before asking for a global zero spectrum.

operations.title: Canonical determinants of norm homology produce no Euler factor
operations.statement: For H_d=(Z/d)^(d-2), rationalization is zero, so every rational determinant det(1-uF) equals 1. On the canonical p-primary associated graded, the intrinsic prime operator P_p=p is nilpotent, hence det(1-uP_p)=1. Choosing an invertible scalar or Adams index imports an unselected Frobenius datum. Thus the current norm module yields no nontrivial Euler factor.
operations.scope: Negative determinant result for the present algebraic norm module; not a no-go for enlarged geometric cohomology.

operations.title: Two-route Euler determinant hostile test
operations.procedure: Compute determinants after rationalization and on the p-primary associated graded. The first vector space is zero; the second prime operator is nilpotent with all eigenvalues zero.
operations.expected_result: Both determinants equal 1. A canonical nonzero eigenvalue or nontrivial determinant from the same typed data would falsify the claim.
